name: The Sandhamn Murders
description: Viveca Stens popular novels come to life in "The Sandhamn Murders", a perfect mix of Nordic crime & the beautiful surroundings of the outer Stockholm archipelago.

videos.title: I de lugnaste vatten (1)
videos.overview: A body is in the water, and the Stockholm police have been notified. At first it seems to be a drowning accident, but the detective assigned to the case Thomas Andreasson soon suspects that it is a murder case.

videos.title: The Price of Power (1)
videos.overview: Nora and Jonas are invited to a summer party at some neighbors' house to inaugurate their newly built luxury house on the island. But the large construction project has angered many of the islanders and the party ends in disaster.

videos.title: The Price of Power (2)
videos.overview: Nora and Jonas are invited to a summer party at some neighbors' house to inaugurate their newly built luxury house on the island. But the large construction project has angered many of the islanders and the party ends in disaster.

videos.title: In the Name of the Truth (1)
videos.overview: It's time for this year's sailing camp at Knarrholmen and the atmosphere is full of anticipation, but Benjamin is immediately chosen as the pick of the bunch by the older guys. At the same time, there is someone lurking in the shadows, watching every step the children take.

videos.title: In the Name of the Truth (2)
videos.overview: It's time for this year's sailing camp at Knarrholmen and the atmosphere is full of anticipation, but Benjamin is immediately chosen as the pick of the bunch by the older guys. At the same time, there is someone lurking in the shadows, watching every step the children take.

videos.title: In the Wrong Company (1)
videos.overview: Mia tries to protect a new mother who is being hunted by her abusive husband. Nora is in the middle of a new criminal case while planning for the wedding. Jonas struggles with jealousy after news of the bachelorette party.

videos.title: In the Wrong Company (2)
videos.overview: Mia tries to protect a new mother who is being hunted by her abusive husband. Nora is in the middle of a new criminal case while planning for the wedding. Jonas struggles with jealousy after news of the bachelorette party.

videos.title: In Sickness and in Health (1)
videos.overview: Mia is brutally humiliated at work and Thomas is determined to bring the guilty to justice. Nora tries to move on from Jonas' betrayal and reluctantly shows up at a 60th birthday party where her ex Henrik invites her to dance.

videos.title: In Sickness and in Health (2)
videos.overview: Mia is brutally humiliated at work and Thomas is determined to bring the guilty to justice. Nora tries to move on from Jonas' betrayal and reluctantly shows up at a 60th birthday party where her ex Henrik invites her to dance.

videos.title: Blue Lies (1)
videos.overview: Just before the peak season for all the student parties, the police receive alarming reports of several deaths caused by a new chemical drug. Nora gets the case on her desk and meets with the new police officer Alexander.

videos.title: Blue Lies (2)
videos.overview: Anna's trail leads to the marina in Stavsnäs and Nora goes in search of Anna's mysterious boyfriend. At the same time, Alexander receives information that a young unconscious woman is being treated at Södersjukhuset. Could it be Anna?

videos.title: The Twins (1)
videos.overview: Sebastian, CEO of the family business Strömma Cement AB, goes behind his family's backs when he contacts real estate entrepreneur Wilhelm Bauer in hopes of settling his gambling debts. At the same time, Nora Bauer is investigating for accounting fraud.

videos.title: The Twins (2)
videos.overview: Jonna is shaken by the latest developments and makes one bad decision after another. Alexander investigates the murder with his new colleague Miriam, but also keeps up to date with Nora's investigations.

videos.title: The Promise (1)
videos.overview: Alexander and Miriam start a new murder investigation when a woman's body is found in a fishing net. Meanwhile, Nora's friend Kristina is looking forward to spending the summer in Sandhamn with her new love Anders, whom she met through a dating app.

videos.title: The Promise (2)
videos.overview: Alexander and Miriam investigate Sara's abandoned cabin. They also gain access to Sara's dating account and try to arrange a date with a guy of particular interest. Anders goes home to confront his wife about the divorce.

videos.title: Vicky (1)
videos.overview: Newly-appointed doctor Carl-Johan throws a big house party, where his adult children struggle to keep up the facade. However, the party comes to an abrupt end when Nora's daughter Anna witnesses a nasty incident.

videos.title: Vicky (2)
videos.overview: Carl-Johan's children and wife are all suspects in the murder, but it is his youngest daughter Vicky who is under arrest. Meanwhile, Alexander is determined to find out what his missing wife has been up to all these years.

videos.title: Angelica (1)
videos.overview: Alexander and Stenmark catch a burglar red-handed, but he refuses to talk until he meets Nora. He claims to know what happened to the missing Angelica, a case that is highly important to Nora.

videos.title: Angelica (2)
videos.overview: Angelica is found dead on a construction site and Stenmark makes an unexpected confession when the police secure a DNA trace at the scene. Sylvester has pictures that tie Angelica's husband Leo to the murder and decides to put pressure on him.

videos.title: Lili (1)
videos.overview: When Sweden's most famous golfer, Teo Skog, reports his wife missing, Stenmark gives the case top priority, but could it be that Teo knows more than he's telling? Nora is courted by her ex, Jonas, who has resurfaced.

videos.title: Lili (2)
videos.overview: Stenmark is annoyed that Alexander and Valpen refuse to leave Teo alone, but the testimonies are conflicting. Nora is drawn closer to the case when it turns out that Lili is an old family friend. At the same time, she continues to have Jonas as an unwanted guest.

videos.title: Olivia (1)
videos.overview: The LVU home is on a trip when two of the young people escape. A guy, Sebbe, steals a boat and it is assumed that his friend Olivia is also with him. Sebbe's escapade comes to an abrupt end and only then does it become clear that Olivia is actually gone.

videos.title: Olivia (2)
videos.overview: Nathalie acts desperate to make people take her seriously. Alexander hears the news on the radio and reacts immediately, without listening to Stenmark's orders. Olivia is still missing and Pär is starting to get really worried.

videos.title: Nadia (1)
videos.overview: Nora finds an unconscious woman on the beach during her morning jog. The woman, named Nadia, tells them she has been trafficked, but refuses to go to the police. Alexander is tricked on a blind date.

videos.title: Nadia (2)
videos.overview: The French police show great interest in the abandoned boat that has been found outside Sandhamn. A dead man has washed up on the beach, and it turns out to be a wanted person. Nadia reacts with horror when Nora receives a visit.

videos.title: Esther (1)
videos.overview: Two skeletons are found in an underground cellar. The remains turn out to belong to two young people who disappeared from a confirmation camp 30 years ago. Now everyone from that year group is called in for questioning; including Nora, Henrik and Gisela.

videos.title: Esther (2)
videos.overview: Henrik remembers that Esther pondered a lot about what the Bible really meant in relation to love. Nora feels sad about all the old memories that come up in the police interrogations, and Alexander steps in to support her.

videos.title: Max (1)
videos.overview: Just when everything is starting to look good for Alexander and Nora, a mysterious man appears and begins to shadow them. He even approaches Tor at his school. The question is, what does he want? Pär takes on his first, very own, case.

videos.title: Max (2)
videos.overview: Nora is worried about Alexander, who has gone missing. Pär realizes that his case is linked to two police investigations, and gets help from Valpen. Meanwhile, the clock is ticking down on a time bomb that threatens to destroy everything.

videos.title: Madeleine (1)
videos.overview: A few months have passed since the bombing of the police station. At the nursing home where a police officer is being rehabilitated, the staff make a horrific discovery. An acquaintance returns from the dead and Nora is drawn into the investigation in an unexpected way.

videos.title: Madeleine (2)
videos.overview: The traces of the murder lead into a world where nothing is what it seems and where old debts must be paid. After everything that has happened, Nora wants to move on in life, but one of her closest people makes a decision that has major consequences.

videos.title: Nikki and Evelina (1)
videos.overview: Friends from the past meet in the archipelago, and Nora's daughter Anna comes home. In the summer greenery, a battered boat dealer is discovered. Alexander is back, both at work and in Nora's life, but there is something he cannot tell.

videos.title: Nikki and Evelina (2)
videos.overview: The killer strikes again. In the archipelago, a woman is kidnapped after appealing to Nora for help. Anna gets involved at the same time as Alexander's double game deepens, which turns out to have fatal consequences.

videos.title: Birgitta (1)
videos.overview: A detective queen is poisoned in her home, surrounded by her invited guests. It soon turns out that one of the suspects has a connection to Nora. The investigation runs into unexpected problems and behind the scenes Alexander's problems worsen.

videos.title: Birgitta (2)
videos.overview: One of Nora's closest relatives becomes the main suspect in the case and Henrik asks her for help. The tracks turn out to reveal secrets from the past. The solution is within reach, but at the same time Nora is faced with a difficult choice.

videos.title: Linnéa (1)
videos.overview: A company executive dies dramatically at a launch party. Alexander and Valpen take on the case and the new police chief Rakel calls in Nora as prosecutor. Alexander and Nora have had no contact since Nora's betrayal.

videos.title: Linnéa (2)
videos.overview: One of the suspects is kidnapped and the case takes a new turn. The new police chief, Rakel, clearly sets the agenda. Both Nora and Alexander feel alone, in their own ways. Valpen does what he can for his colleague.

videos.title: Rakel (1)
videos.overview: Rakel's son owes a man a large sum of money and makes a fatal mistake. Rakel does everything in her power to help him, but it won't be easy. Nora tries to reconcile with Alexander. But things don't go as planned.

videos.title: Rakel (2)
videos.overview: Nora and Alexander are once again far apart. The investigation continues despite Rakel's attempts to interrupt. Alexander and Valpen find a warehouse where they encounter both contraband and fierce resistance, an encounter that ends in horror.

videos.title: Amanda (1)
videos.overview: A robbery goes awry, leading to the kidnapping of a little girl. Alexander and Valpen are first on the scene but don't have time to stop the robbers. When Nora discovers a broken window at her neighbors' house, she finds herself right in the middle of the action.

videos.title: Amanda (2)
videos.overview: The kidnapped girl suffers from a rare disease and Nora manages to convince her captors that she needs medical attention, but there are consequences. Meanwhile, Alexander, Valpen and Emma try to locate the perpetrators.
